αἱμονίδαο: Αἱμονίδης — son of Haemon, patronymic; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
αὐδήσασκεν: αὐδάω — speak, say aloud; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic (Attic ηὔδησε): ’would speak, used to speak’
αὐτόμεδον: Αὐτομέδων — Automedon, Achilles’ charioteer and companion; masc. voc. sg., recessive accent in address (nom. Αὐτομέδων)
βαλόντε: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual (root aor. ἔβαλον): ’the two having thrown’
βαλῶ: βάλλω — throw, cast, put; fut. 1 sg. act. (Attic βαλῶ is the same): ’I will cast, I will put’
βλεφάρων: βλέφαρον — eyelid; neut. gen. pl., after κατά: ’down from the eyelids’
βοείην: βόειος — of an ox; fem. acc. sg. used as a noun, ’oxhide’ (= Attic βοείαν)
γούνατά: γόνυ — knee; neut. nom. pl., epic γούνατα (= Attic γόνατα), accented before an enclitic
δειλώ: δειλός — wretched, miserable, poor; masc. voc. dual, in address: ’you two wretched ones’
διώρεος: Διώρης — Diores, father of Automedon; masc. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
δμῆσίν: δμῆσις — taming, mastery (from δάμνημι); fem. acc. sg., accented before an enclitic
δυστήνοισι: δύστηνος — wretched, unhappy, ill-fated; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
δύνει: δύνω (by-form of δύω) — sink in, go into; pres. 3 sg. act., of a general process in a comparison: ’sinks in’
εἴπεσκε: εἶπον (aor. of λέγω/φημί) — say, speak; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic (Attic εἶπε): ’would say, used to say’
εἵλκεον: ἕλκω — drag, draw, pull; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented, epic -εον (= Attic εἷλκον): ’were dragging’
ζεύγλης: ζεύγλη — yoke-loop (the exact part of the harness is not certain); fem. gen. sg., of separation with ἐξεριποῦσα: ’from the yoke-loop’
θαλερὴ: θαλερός — blooming, luxuriant, abundant; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with χαίτη
θείνων: θείνω — strike, beat; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., of manner: ’striking’
θνητῷ: θνητός — mortal, subject to death; masc. dat. sg., in apposition to Πηλῆϊ: ’a mortal’
καρήατα: κάρη — head; neut. acc. pl. καρήατα, epic (Attic κάρα)
κιχάνει: κιχάνω — overtake, come upon, reach; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’overtakes’ (epic and poetic; Attic καταλαμβάνει expresses the sense)
κλαῖον: κλαίω — weep, wail; impf. 3 pl. (or 1 sg.) act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔκλαιον): ’were weeping’
μάχεαι: μάχομαι — fight; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic μάχῃ): ’you fight’
μάχετ: μάχομαι — fight; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented and elided (μάχετ’ = μάχετο; Attic ἐμάχετο): ’fought’
μαρναμένοιιν: μάρναμαι — fight; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. (or dat.) dual, epic -οιιν (= Attic -οιν): ’of the two fighting’
μεθύουσαν: μεθύω — be drunk, be soaked, saturated; pres. part. act. fem. acc. sg.: ’soaked’, with ἀλοιφῇ of the substance
μυρομένοισιν: μύρομαι — weep, lament; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
μυρομένω: μύρομαι — weep, lament; pres. part. mid. masc. nom./acc. dual: ’the two weeping’
μῶλος: μῶλος — toil of battle, struggle, strife; masc. nom. sg.
νηκερδέα: νηκερδής — profitless, unprofitable (νη- ’not’ + κέρδος); fem. acc. sg., epic -έα (= Attic -ῆ), agreeing with βουλήν
πανημερίοις: πανημέριος — lasting all day, all day long (πᾶς + ἦμαρ); masc. dat. pl., agreeing with τοῖς: ’to them all day long’
πλατὺν: πλατύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἑλλήσποντον
πνείει: πνέω — breathe; pres. 3 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic πνεῖ)
πυθέσθην: πυνθάνομαι — learn, hear, find out; aor. 2/3 dual mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπυθέσθην): ’the two learned’
πόθῳ: πόθος — longing, yearning (for one lost); masc. dat. sg., of cause: ’out of longing’
σεύαιτο: σεύω — set in motion; mid. rush, dash; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., in a past general clause after ὅτε: ’whenever he dashed’
σιδήρειος: σιδήρειος — of iron, iron; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic σιδηροῦς), agreeing with ὀρυμαγδός
στήλη: στήλη — upright slab, pillar, gravestone; fem. nom. sg.
τάνυται: τανύω — stretch, draw out; pres. 3 sg. pass. (mid.): ’is stretched’
τανύειν: τανύω — stretch, draw out; pres. inf. act., after δώῃ: ’to stretch’
τανύουσι: τανύω — stretch (a hide, a bow); pres. 3 pl. act.: ’they stretch’
ταύροιο: ταῦρος — bull; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
τεθνηότα: θνῄσκω — die; perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic τεθνεῶτα): ’dead’, supplementary after ᾔδεε
τεθνηότος: θνῄσκω — die; perf. part. act. masc. gen. sg. (= Attic τεθνεῶτος): ’of one dead’
φεύγεσκεν: φεύγω — flee, run away; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic (= Attic ἔφευγεν): ’would flee, used to flee’
χαίτη: χαίτη — long hair, mane; fem. nom. sg.
χαιτάων: χαίτη — long hair, mane; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
χεῖρές: χείρ — hand; fem. nom. pl., accented before an enclitic
χώρῃ: χώρα (Ionic χώρη) — place, spot, space; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic χώρᾳ)
ἀγάλλεται: ἀγάλλομαι — exult, glory, take pride; pres. 3 sg. mid. dep.: ’exults’
ἀλκίμεδον: Ἀλκιμέδων — Alcimedon, a Myrmidon, son of Laerces; masc. voc. sg., recessive accent in address (nom. Ἀλκιμέδων)
ἀλοιφὴ: ἀλοιφή — fat, grease, anything smeared on; fem. nom. sg.
ἀπαγγέλλεσκε: ἀπαγγέλλω — report, carry word; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic (Attic ἀπήγγελλε): ’used to report’
ἀργαλέης: ἀργαλέος — grievous, painful, hard; fem. gen. sg., epic -ης (= Attic -ας)
ἀρειῇ: ἀρειή — threat, menace (rare; the usual explanation); fem. dat. sg., of manner: ’with threats’
ἀφίκωνται: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive, reach; aor. subj. 3 pl. mid., after εἰς ὅ κε: ’until they reach’
ἐγχρίμπτοντο: ἐγχρίμπτω — press close, drive against; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐνεχρίμπτοντο): ’pressed close’
ἐκπέρσειν: ἐκπέρθω — sack, destroy utterly (Attic ἐκπορθέω); fut. inf. act., after ἔλπετο: ’to sack’
ἐμιαίνετο: μιαίνω — stain, soil, defile; impf. 3 sg. pass., augmented: ’was soiled’
ἐνέπνευσεν: ἐμπνέω — breathe into, inspire; aor. 3 sg. (ἐν- preverb) + acc. and dat.: ’breathed into’
ἐνισκίμψαντε: ἐνισκίμπτω — plant in, fix in; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual, + dat.: ’the two having fixed in’
ἐνιχριμφθέντα: ἐγχρίμπτω (here with the epic preverb ἐνι-) — press close, drive against; aor. pass. part. masc. acc. sg., intrans. sense, + dat.: ’having pressed close’
ἐξεριποῦσα: ἐξερείπω — fall down out of, drop out; 2nd aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., + gen. of separation: ’dropping down from’
ἐπίσχειν: ἐπίσχω (= ἐπέχω) — hold in, hold back, rein in; pres. inf. act.: ’to hold in’
ἐπαΐξασκε: ἐπαΐσσω — dart upon, rush on; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic (Attic ἐπῇξε): ’would rush on, used to dash on’
ἐπεύθετο: πεύθομαι (epic present by-form of πυνθάνομαι) — learn, inquire, hear; impf. mid. 3 sg. ἐπεύθετο, augmented: ’learned’
ἐρωείτω: ἐρωέω — draw back, hold back, recoil; pres. imper. 3 sg. act., + gen. of what one holds back from (Attic ἀναχωρεῖν expresses the sense): ’let him hold back’
ἐρύσαι: ἐρύω — draw, drag; aor. inf. act. (Attic ἑλκύσαι or ἕλξαι expresses the sense): ’to drag’
ἐσθλάς: ἐσθλός — good, noble; fem. acc. pl.
ἐφορμᾶσθαι: ἐφορμάομαι — rush upon, attack; pres. inf. mid. dep., contracted: ’to attack’, with ἔγχει of means
ἐϋκλεὲς: ἐϋκλεής — of good fame, glorious (εὖ + κλέος); neut. nom. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὐκλεές), predicate with an infinitive
ἐόνθ: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (ἐόνθ’ = ἐόντα; Attic ὄντα): ’being’
ἑλκόντων: ἕλκω — drag, pull, draw; pres. part. act. masc. gen. pl., in a genitive absolute: ’with (many) pulling’
ἑστήκῃ: ἵστημι — set up; perf. act. ἕστηκα ’stand’; perf. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative clause with no ἄν/κε: ’stands’
ἔχητον: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. subj. 2/3 dual, after ἵνα: ’that you two may have’
ἕρπει: ἕρπω — creep, move along, crawl; pres. 3 sg. act.
ἠΰ: ἠΰς — good, noble (epic by-form of ἐΰς; Attic ἀγαθός); neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with μένος
ἧμιν: ἐγώ — I, we; dat. pl., epic ἧμιν (= Attic ἡμῖν): ’to us, for us’
ἰκμὰς: ἰκμάς — moisture, wetness; fem. nom. sg.
ἱδρῷ: ἱδρώς — sweat; masc. dat. sg., epic ἱδρῷ (= Attic ἱδρῶτι), of means: ’with sweat’
ἱερῷ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with δίφρῳ
ὀλίγῃ: ὀλίγος — little, small, slight; fem. dat. sg.
ὀνόσαιτ: ὄνομαι — make light of, scorn; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., elided (ὀνόσαιτ’ = ὀνόσαιτο), potential with κ’: ’would make light of’
ὀρέξω: ὀρέγω — stretch out, hold out, extend; fut. 1 sg. act.: ’I will extend, I will grant’
ὀϊζυρώτερον: ὀϊζυρός — wretched, sorrowful (ὀϊζύς ’woe’); comparative neut. nom. sg., with ἀνδρός of comparison: ’more sorrowful than’
ὄρσασκεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic (Attic ὦρσε): ’would rouse, used to rouse’
ὑπένερθεν: ὑπένερθε(ν) — below, beneath, from beneath; adv. in -θεν (Attic ὑποκάτω expresses the sense)
ὤλεθ: ὄλλυμι (mid. ὄλλυμαι) — perish, be destroyed, die; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (ὤλεθ’ = ὤλετο): ’he perished’

__broaden__.ζυγὸν: ζυγόν — yoke; neut. acc. sg., after ὑπό in tmesis with ἤγαγεν: ’under the yoke’ · also neut. acc. sg., after ὑπέρ: ’over the yoke’ (ὑπὲρ ζυγόν) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of ἦεν (the yoke of a lyre): ’a yoke’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of ἐέργει: ’the yoke’ (ζυγὸν … ἐέργει ’the yoke keeps (them) apart’) · also neut. acc. sg., after παρά: ’beside the yoke’ (παρὰ ζυγόν)
__broaden__.ἕθεν: ἕ, οὗ — of himself, him, her; 3 sg. pron., gen. sg., epic ἕθεν (= Attic οὗ); with πρόσθεν, πρό: ’in front of him’, reflexive ’in front of himself’ · also gen. sg. after ἀπό: ’from himself’ (ἀπὸ ἕθεν … ὤσατο ’pushed away from himself’) · also gen. sg. after εἵνεκα: ’for his sake’ · also gen. sg. after ἄνευ: ’without him’ (ἄνευ ἕθεν)
__broaden__.τόσον: τόσος — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’only so far’ · also correlative with ὅσον, neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’so loudly, so much’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, with οὔ τι: ’so much’ (οὔ τι τόσον ’not so much’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, with a verb of coming: ’so greatly’ (τόσον ἵκει ’comes so greatly’) · also neut. acc. sg. adj., agreeing with κακόν and correlative with ὅσσον: ’so great’ (κακὸν τόσον ὅσσον ’an evil so great as’)
__broaden__.τῷδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., masc. dat. sg., standing alone: ’this man’ · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἤματι: ’this’ (ἤματι τῷδε ’on this day’) · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with στείνεϊ: ’this (tight spot)’ · also masc. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀνέρι: ’this (man)’ (ἀνέρι τῷδε ’this man’)
__broaden__.χάλκεον: χάλκεος — of bronze; neut. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦν) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος: ’of bronze’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος: ’of bronze’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὕπνον: ’of bronze’ (χάλκεον ὕπνον ’a bronze sleep’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οὐρανόν: ’of bronze’ (χάλκεον οὐρανόν ’the bronze heaven’)
__broaden__.λαοσσόος: λαοσσόος — rousing the host (λαός + σεύω; derivation disputed), epithet of Athena; fem. nom. sg. of a two-ending adjective · also masc. nom. sg., epithet of Ares
__broaden__.σφῶϊν: σύ (dual σφῶϊ) — you two; dual gen./dat. 2nd person, epic (= Attic σφῷν): ’of you two’ · also dat. dual, of interest or place: ’in you two, to you two’ (σφῶϊν ἐν γούνεσσι ’in your knees’)
__broaden__.δώῃ: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg. (= Attic δῷ), after αἴ κε: ’may grant’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a clause joined to εἰ κ’ + subj.: ’grants’ (δώῃ δέ μοι εὖχος ’and grants me glory’) · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a comparison after ὡς ὅτε, without κε: ’gives’ (+ inf., ’gives to stretch’)
__broaden__.μεθήσομεν: μεθίημι — let go, slacken, give up; fut. 1 pl. (the -σ- marks a future, not a subjunctive), deliberative: ’are we to slacken?’ · also fut. 1 pl. indic. in a condition after εἰ: ’we shall give up’ (εἰ … μεθήσομεν ’if we shall give up’)
__broaden__.ἵκοι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, come upon; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a general clause after ὅτε κε: ’came upon’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., in a concessive condition after οὐδ’ εἰ: ’were to come upon’ (οὐδ’ εἰ … χόλος ἵκοι ’not even if wrath were to come upon him’)
__broaden__.ἵπποις: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. pl., object of ἕπομαι (+ dat.): ’horses’ · also masc. dat. pl., of accompaniment: ’with the horses’ (ἵπποις ἀΐσσων ’darting with the horses’)
__broaden__.ἐπεμαίετο: ἐπιμαίομαι — reach after, touch, grope for (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐπεμαῖτο): ’was reaching after’ · also impf. 3 sg. with a dative of the instrument and a participle: ’kept lashing at’ (μάστιγι … ἐπεμαίετο θείνων ’kept lashing with the whip, striking’)
__broaden__.κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also εἰ … κ’ + subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ · also ἐπεί κ’ + aor. subj., prospective temporal: ’when, once’ · also εἰς ὅ κ’ + opt., ’until … should’ · also κ’ + opt., potential: ’would’ (οὐδέ κ’ … ὀνόσαιτ’ ’nor would … make light of’)
